about_the_game:
Mount your horse. Lower your lance. Hit the Quintain.

This is the free demo of The Lists VR, a virtual reality jousting simulation set in 15th-century Salzburg, Austria, in the shadow of Fortress Hohensalzburg. In this early version, you’ll enter the Practice Grounds, where knights train their skills against Quintains, rotating targets historically used to perfect timing, aim, and technique.

This demo is focused entirely on the feel of the ride:

  • Practice your lance technique on moving Quintains

  • Control your mount and weapon with full-body immersion

  • Learn the technique and timing required for facing tournament opponents

Note

This demo does not include AI opponents, tournaments, or campaign progression. Those are coming in the full release of The Lists VR, where you’ll compete in full tournaments with a dynamic scoring system.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel i5-7600 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 / AMD RX 580 (6GB VRAM minimum)
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • VR Support: OpenXR (Oculus Rift, Meta Quest via Link, Valve Index) — Requires motion controllers.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel i7-9700K / AMD Ryzen 5 3600 or better
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2070 / AMD RX 6700 XT or better
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
  • VR Support: OpenXR (Oculus Rift, Meta Quest via Link, Valve Index) — Requires motion controllers.

short_description: Mount your horse, lower your lance, and experience the thrill of medieval jousting in full virtual reality. The Lists VR puts you directly on the tournament field in 15th-century Europe. Compete in a focused, skill-based jousting experience where your body becomes the controller.
